==Description==
'''Unknown Garden''' is a [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]]-exclusive [[Maps|map]] that takes place at night on a floating island.

==Design & Path==
{{Tabber
|Current
|'''Unknown Garden''' is a small garden sanctuary located on a mountain. It is inhabited by a few void creatures which can be seen sitting on benches. The garden contains various plants, including trees, potted plants, flowers, vines and other miscellaneous plants. The garden contains a stone path surrounded by a few stone walls. On these paths, there are a few benches, one of them placed at the edge of a cliff, overlooking the purple river in the distance. There is also a [[Two X]] statue in the middle of the sanctuary. In one corner, there is also an additional statue where someone is holding another person in their hands.

The path starts at the purple portal and ends at an orange portal. The path moves across the stone ground seen in the garden.
|Version 1
|'''Unknown Garden''' took place on a floating island in space with a destroyed garden. The garden in some parts wais surrounded by dark purple hills, fences or walls. In the garden, multiple purple trees with purple flames coming out of them could be found. There were also multiple destroyed buildings there, with only some parts of their walls left. On the hills, multiple humanoids were on them, two of them being [[Vindicator (Legacy)|Vindicator]]s and two being [[Soul Stealer (Legacy)|Soul Stealer]]s. The other humanoids do not appear to be any enemies currently in the game.

The path started and ended at a portal. The path takes multiple turns, avoiding natural terrain or destroyed buildings.
}}

==Rewards==
The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map.

Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal.

{{Rewards|Normal|Easy = Hide|Casual = Hide|Intermediate = Hide|Molten = Hide|Fallen = Hide}}

==Strategy==
*This map has multiple spots which are great for the [[Ace Pilot]].
*This map has quite a lot of cliffs, making cliff towers such as the [[Ranger]] and [[Mortar]] useful here.
**This map is also quite large, cliff towers with high range can easily cover most of the path.

==Trivia==
*Multiple characters can be seen sitting on benches of this map, though they do not resemble any enemies.
**In the first version of this map, multiple humanoids could also be seen on the sides of the mountains, some of them being [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode enemies, like the [[Vindicator (Legacy)|Vindicator]] and [[Soul Stealer (Legacy)|Soul Stealer]].
*This map has a theme similar to [[Voidlands]], a removed [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]]-exclusive map from [[Hardcore Testing BETA]].
